headline: Fortis Healthcare reports Q2 EBITDA growth with margin contraction
summary: Fortis Healthcare reported a 12% increase in EBITDA to ₹623.19 crore for the second quarter, up from ₹556.33 crore in the corresponding period of the previous fiscal year. However, the company's operating margins contracted during the quarter. The earnings report detailed the performance across its various business segments. headline: Fortis Healthcare Q2 profit dips 3% on lower exceptional gains
hook: Margin contraction despite revenue growth at Fortis
summary: Fortis Healthcare reported a 3% decline in quarterly profit, primarily due to a reduction in exceptional gains compared to the previous year. While revenue grew, the company's EBITDA margin narrowed to 22.8% from 23.9% in the same period last year. EBITDA itself rose 12% to ₹623.2 crore, reflecting operational growth despite the margin pressure. Retail investors should note the impact of fluctuating exceptional items on the bottom line.
why_it_matters: Operational margin pressure may weigh on near-term stock performance.
